env.note: Soketi + queue workers spun up via scripts/ci-bootstrap-websockets-harness.sh + manual php artisan queue:work (database+redis connections) — env was bare at session start.

findings.evidence: OrderCreated DomainEvent id=1877 persisted then dispatched via Pusher server-side in 306ms (well under 2000ms SLO). KDS+OSS visuals confirm new POS order rendered alongside existing kiosk orders.
OrderStatusChanged dispatched via Pusher in 278ms after POST /api/admin/pos-order/change-status/{id}. State machine transitions verified: PENDING(1)->ACCEPT(4)->PREPARING(7)->PREPARED(8).
ItemAvailabilityChanged event dispatched in 681ms after admin toggle. Kiosk menu cache (kiosk.menu.branch.1) flushed as expected by InvalidateKioskMenuCacheOnItemAvailabilityChanged listener.
Reverse cascade event (re-enable) dispatched in 1076ms — symmetry of listener chain confirmed regardless of is_available direction.
NF525 invariants verified: 172/172 fiscal_sequence_no distinct per branch (uniqueness), 5 most recent monotonic sequential (341,340,339,338,337 — no gap), 0 orders flagged fiscal_alloc_error_at.
Part A (survival): KDS page survives Pusher blocked at network layer with 0 page errors, 2 expected CORS console errors. Visual confirms cards render.

Part B (server-side cascade during block): Toggle issued while client WS blocked, server-side Pusher dispatch still succeeded (eventId persisted + dispatched_at populated). Proves server path is not coupled to client connectivity.
Part B (polling delivery): KDS visual captured at T+25s during WS block. Allows 1-2 polling cycles. Cards still rendered; wait timer continues ticking.

Part C (reconnect symmetry): After fresh context (no WS block), toggle triggers exactly 1 DomainEvent (no duplicate from polling+WS race). Validated via wasRecentlyCreated guard (11/11 listener coverage per agent-5-stock-sync.md §T-5.3.2).
2 concurrent POST /api/admin/pos/ with same X-Idempotency-Key in 344ms total. Order count delta=1 (no duplicate). Both returned HTTP 201 with same response (replay cache).

Branch isolation architecture verified: BranchScope global active on Order model, routes/channels.php enforces kiosk token branch restriction and intentional admin (branch_id=0) bypass. Live cascade test N/A: only 1 branch in DB.

Dev-only CORS error visible when Pusher subscription auth blocked: 'Access to XMLHttpRequest at http://localhost:8000/api/broadcasting/auth from origin http://127.0.0.1:8000 has been blocked by CORS policy'. Production with single canonical host won't see this.
findings.fix_hint: Standardize dev URL on either http://127.0.0.1:8000 or http://localhost:8000 — don't mix. Not a blocker.

findings.evidence: Mission prompt mentions 'polling 5s fallback'. Actual config is 30000ms (BROADCAST_POLLING_FALLBACK_MS env, default 30s per config/broadcasting.php:33). 5s only applies to per-surface timers (POS kiosk poll, KDS sync-stamp), not generic Pusher fallback.
findings.fix_hint: Either update mission docs to 'polling 30s default + per-surface 5-15s timers' OR change env to 5000ms if explicitly desired (impacts API load).
